title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1699: End of battle (2)

section.p: In the blink of an eye, a new golden stripe appeared on the book.
142 golden stripes.
143 golden stripes.
144 golden stripes.
At that point, the book was only one stripe away from becoming a divine weapon. But a divine weapon was not something that could appear easily.

Even in the entirety of Myriad Realms, there were only a few known divine weapons in existence. The Heavenly Hunt Index was one. The Source Return Blade was one as well. Those were the only two Su Yu knew of.

Done with strengthening the weapon, Su Yu shifted his attention elsewhere. It was unlikely that he could push his book into a divine weapon so easily, so he did not bother worrying about it at this time.

Instead, he returned his attention to the battlefield. The power of Fat Ball was slowly fading from his body. Killing a Daofuse had greatly exhausted the power he had received from the one drop of blood essence he had used. He was left with only two drops of Fat Ball’s blood essence.
At the moment, the various experts were still fighting while fleeing.
Invincibles were dying left and right, filling the sky with phenomena. So many of them were dying that some might even be humans. Su Yu did not have the luxury to focus on the identities of the dead.
Instead, he was busy picking a suitable target to kill. Since they were all fleeing so desperately, he had to make his choice fast. This might be his last chance to kill them for a while.

After giving it some thought, he shot in the direction of the Spirit Pseudo Emperor and Ape Pseudo Emperor without any hesitation. It was pointless to kill the immortal Daofuse. There were simply too many experts in the immortal race. They would remain dangerous as long as Tiangu remained.

As for the two newly arrived immortal Daofuses, he couldn’t be bothered to deal with them either. Perhaps keeping the immortals strong might even cause the divines and devils to be more wary of them. On the other hand, killing the Spirit Pseudo Emperor and Ape Pseudo Emperor would throw their respective races into chaos. Without their Daofuses around, they wouldn’t have the courage to further interfere in the future battles.

After losing their Daofuses, their Invincibles might lose the courage to even leave their realms. Since humanity had produced a Daofuse, all races must be on high alert. Any carelessness could very well result in the extinction of their races. He consumed the second drop of blood essence.
Noting Su Yu’s approach, the Spirit Pseudo Emperor felt a chill creep up her spine. She knew that she had caught Su Yu’s attention.
“All as spirit, open!”

In Su Yu’s vision, the great dao above the Spirit Pseudo Emperor started shaking the moment she shouted. Suddenly, everything around her came alive. The bamboo in the Iron Devourer Pseudo Emperor’s hands started struggling and resisting its master.

As a result, the Iron Devourer Pseudo Emperor was forced to focus on suppressing the bamboo instead of attacking the Spirit Pseudo Emperor. That was a peak heaven weapon. There was no way he would allow it to leave him so easily.

That was not all. Space itself seemed to have come alive as well. A tunnel connecting straight toward the Spirit Realm appeared behind her. Things were getting too dangerous for these Daofuses to keep holding back. Each of them was fighting desperately.

The Ape Pseudo Emperor was fighting just as hard. He instantly grew into a gigantic ape before tearing the space in front of him apart. His staff was tossed aside before exploding. That was a heaven weapon. And it had been detonated just like that. He was using the explosion to buy himself more time. No treasure was worth more than his own life. He was doing everything he could to escape.
Daofuses were at risk of dying in their very first battle of the tenth epoch. Nobody had expected this.
“Woof!”
Just then, Su Yu attacked. A dog appeared in the sky and pounced on Spirit Pseudo Emperor’s dao.

Above the Spirit Pseudo Emperor, a dao appeared. That was the dao of nature. Flowers, plants, mountains, rivers, seas, and lakes could be seen on it. And on that great dao, an incredibly beautiful red flower bloomed.
The red flower was the Spirit Pseudo Emperor’s personal dao, in the process of fusing the great dao of nature.

The Spirit Pseudo Emperor was attempting to flee through a spatial tunnel, but as the dog arrived, she felt an intense sense of crisis. She did not dare to waste any time and stepped directly into the spatial tunnel before it could stabilize. But right at that moment, a powerful pulling force appeared behind her.
“I haven’t eaten anyone!”

It was the female furball. Yes. The female furball. Her mood had worsened compared to earlier. Even after spending an entire day fighting, she had not managed to eat anyone. She didn’t even manage to eat the dead Dragon Pseudo Emperor.
And now, the Spirit Pseudo Emperor was trying to flee right in front of her. Were they looking down on her? They knew how to struggle desperately, but she could do the same!

A gigantic furball appeared in the sky. Her mouth opened wide and released a powerful pulling force, as though it was a black hole. When Su Yu looked up, he saw a dao above the female furball as well.

It wasn’t too big. However, it didn’t feel like a fused dao. Rather, it felt like an original dao. Su Yu wasn’t sure if that was a dao she had opened herself or she herself was a sentient dao. The female furball’s dao wasn’t too powerful, but it was uniquely hers.

Su Yu did not spend too much time looking at the female furball’s dao. Just then, the dog reached the Spirit Pseudo Emperor’s dao and bit down at it. As for Su Yu, he threw numerous punches forward, only to be blocked by countless mountains that had manifested out of thin air. However, Su Yu’s target was the spatial tunnel, not the Spirit Pseudo Emperor.
The pass character activated, teleporting Su Yu’s punches right through the mountains and straight toward the spatial tunnel.
“Don’t even dream of running!”

As the Spirit Pseudo Emperor stepped into the unstable tunnel, it started shaking. And when Su Yu’s punches arrived, it collapsed. At the same time, the powerful pulling force was still dragging her back. A look of despair covered her eyes as she said mournfully, “The humans were the ones who had treated my people as mere materials! The humans were the ones who were too overbearing! Do we, spirits born of nature, not have the right to live?”

She wailed, “That book, that plant, and even these soul devourers, all of them are spirits! As fellow spirits, why are you helping the tyrants? The current human lord won’t kill you because he requires your help. But when humanity regains its power, you will all be turned into materials as well!”
Was there right or wrong here?
No.
Yes. That was indeed what the ancient humans had done. Su Yu knew it must have been the case.
But was he wrong?
He did not think so. He, too, was seeking survival. The survival of humanity.
The Spirit Pseudo Emperor was a Daofuse who had joined the battle with more than ten Eternals, nearly causing humanity’s defeat when she appeared.
In wars between races, there was no right or wrong.
Of the various races in existence, nobody was right. And nobody was wrong. All of them were simply fighting for their respective races.

The immortals might be annoying, but they had also done all that for the sake of their race. They wanted to conquer the Myriad Realms. But since the humans had done so once, it was only fair that the immortals wanted to do the same. There was no villain in this story.
It was normal for a race to want to lead. And strength would determine whether that ambition could be fulfilled.
For Su Yu, Tiangu was a villain. For the immortals, Tiangu was a hero.
Thus, Su Yu remained completely unaffected even after hearing Spirit Pseudo Emperor’s words. Up in the sky, the dog attacked the red flower madly.
As for Su Yu himself, he teleported forward before swinging the Culture Tomb as a saber.
One acupoint, one technique.
One acupoint, one cultivation method.
Upon reaching the Sunmoon Realm, all his acupoints had fused into one. There was no longer any need for him to use any specific cultivation method or technique to boost the prowess of his attack.
But he was still using the Sky Sundering Saber because he was already used to it.

The attack missed. Right at that moment, a certain fragrance entered his nose. His entire body started shaking intensely. That fragrance was not poisonous. It was tonic, and it was giving his body an excessive amount of vigor.

Even his sea of willpower was being boosted excessively by the fragrance. Even the power of Fat Ball in Su Yu’s body was boosted. Unable to withstand such power, his body started tearing apart. This was a demonstration of how excessive tonic could turn toxic.

The pale Spirit Pseudo Emperor continued fleeing after slowing Su Yu down. No Daofuse was a fool. And no Daofuse was a weakling. Having sensed that even the strength of her dao was not a match for the current Su Yu. Thus, she could only flee. To do that, she had to give him such a big boost of strength that he lost control ver his own power.

No matter how strong he was currently, he was using borrowed power. It was far easier to lose control over borrowed power. Yes. The Spirit Pseudo Emperor could sense that Su Yu was using borrowed power.

If they were fighting alone, this trick might have really worked. Unfortunately for the Spirit Pseudo Emperor, Su Yu was not alone. Right at that moment, the female furball’s devouring force reached its peak, causing even space itself to shatter.
The Spirit Pseudo Emperor had barely moved when the space around her collapsed. Behind her, the female furball roared and bit down at her.
“Eat you!”
The female furball roared.

At the same moment, Su Yu recovered from his loss of control. He was quite shocked, but he understood that this was the disadvantage of using borrowed power. The same trick wouldn’t have worked on the white dog himself.
Sure enough, only his own strength was more reliable. Because he was using borrowed power, the Spirit Pseudo Emperor had nearly escaped.
“Since you enjoy boosting my power, I suggest that you die. That will give me an even bigger boost.”

Su Yu swung his saber again. At the same time, he roared and activated the golden book. As the book shook, numerous lines shot out of its many pages. Far away, Mo Ji’s head snapped in Su Yu’s direction. Even further away, the Divine Pseudo Emperor looked at Su Yu as well.
Several daos seemed to have appeared above Su Yu’s head.
Since he was using borrowed power here, he might as well borrow from more sources.
Divine Possession.
Devil’s Descend.
Racial abilities.

Yes. He was using the racial abilities of other races. At this point, he could already understand how this worked. Having consumed so many experts of the various races, the Book of Time had formed a basic version of the daos of the myriad races. That was the origin of all the racial abilities Su Yu had used.
It felt as though Su Yu had stolen the power from the great daos of the two races. That was why the two top experts of those races sensed it the moment he activated the two racial abilities.
Mo Ji, who was fighting the old turtle, paled and muttered, “Time Sage!”
He had just awakened from his deep slumber, but he could see what Su Yu was doing with a single glance.

Su Yu had Time Sage’s inheritance as well! He had the ability to steal from the great daos of the various races! For the very first time, Su Yu could clearly feel what the Book of Time was doing. It was stealing from the various great daos.
The Time Sage was scary indeed. Another burst of strength erupted from inside Su Yu’s body as he transformed into wind before shooting forward again.

That seemed to be the final straw to break the camel’s back as the Spirit Pseudo Emperor was finally forced back into her true form: a red flower. The moment she transformed back into her true form, an intense fragrance spread everywhere.

As for the dao above her, it could no longer flee. It was torn into pieces by the fierce white dog. The moment the red flower was ripped apart, the great dao it adhered to fled before the dog could pounce on it as well.
The Spirit Pseudo Emperor started trembling violently. Her aura started dropping. With boundless despair, she wailed.
“Even if I die, I won’t be your food!”
The red flower exploded.
